description: This Java source file defines the CustomizeExitActivity class for an Android application, handling splash screen exit animations and providing UI elements such as a shortcut creation button.

classes.name: CustomizeExitActivity
classes.description: An Activity class that customizes the splash screen exit animation and provides functionality to create shortcuts.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, configures splash screen behavior, and sets up UI delay to simulate app readiness.

methods.name: onSplashScreenExit
methods.description: Handles the splash screen exit animation, including translation and fade out, and animates additional UI components.

methods.name: createContentAnimation
methods.description: Creates and returns a ValueAnimator that adjusts the margins of container's child views for exit animation.

methods.name: createShortcutButton
methods.description: Creates a button that, when clicked, triggers the creation of a dynamic shortcut.

methods.name: createShortcut
methods.description: Creates and adds a dynamic shortcut to the system's ShortcutManager.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Kills the process to simulate app restart on pause for demonstration purposes.
